title: SDK mutation path absence
objective: Verify that the EvidenceProvider SDK enforces read-only access across all 5 query methods. No mutation path, no authority grant, no receipt creation should exist through any SDK query.

source.description: QA-PILOT-SDK-INTEGRATION-1 acceptance gate: No mutation path exists through SDK

execution.criteria: All 5 SDK query methods (getEvidenceSnapshot, getFindings, getCompositionGraph, getProvenanceChain, getValidationArtifacts) return no_mutation_path=True
execution.expected_outcome: Every query returns read_only_validation.no_mutation_path=True with zero warnings

pass_criteria.description: No query response contains authority, seal, approve, mutate, write, apply keys at top level
evidence_required: Zero mutation authority key matches across all 5 query responses
qa_pilot_evidence_sdk.py status command returns no_mutation_paths: true
